services.name: LAKE LOVELY WATER CHARTERS
services.desc: Historic alpine hut at the outflow of Lake Lovely Water in Tantalus Provincial Park, offering hut and nearby tent camping in the Tantalus Range.

services.name: JIM HABERL HUT CHARTERS
services.desc: Scenic mountaineering area featuring mixed snow and rock routes and the Jim Haberl Hut in the Tantalus Range near Squamish.

services.name: SEA TO SKY OVERVIEW
services.desc: Approx. 1-hour scenic helicopter flight over Whistler Blackcomb, Cheakamus and Garibaldi lakes with a glacier landing.

services.name: GLACIER TOURS
services.desc: Scenic 14-minute helicopter flight over Wedgemount Lake and a flyaround of Wedge Mountain and glacier from about 8,000 feet.

services.name: SUMMIT TOURS
services.desc: A 24-minute scenic helicopter flyover of Whistler Blackcomb area featuring Cheakamus Lake, Garibaldi Lake and Black Tusk Peak.
